contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete possible curse tablet probably of the Roman period, dating from c. AD 43 - c. AD 410. The object is broadly rectangular in plan and rectangular in section. The object is formed of a thin lead strip that has been folded over and over approximately six times, along the length of the strip.
